description: This file defines the AccessEmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Maintenance plugin. It manages access control and rendering logic for employee access features in the web application, utilizing traits for authentication and configuration, and setting up a Vue.js component for the UI.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee access in the Maintenance plugin, extending Vue.js controller functionalities and implementing admin privilege checks.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, initializing a component with an identifier property retrieved from configuration.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, checking for admin access and redirecting unauthorized users.
